timing_scope: CUDA event average over complete CUDA graph replay; quantization/publisher/clears/FC1/FC2 included; router/topk and weight preparation excluded identically

domain_precheck.row_order: canonical by token/route slot; physical atomic placement may differ

reference_precheck.scope: Full valid routed domain, FP64 accumulation; exploratory thresholds, not production acceptance

scalar_workspace_runtime.scope: Live field read after graph warmup, outside timing

component_diagnostic.scope: Each sample is one standalone component graph after full-call preparation and output clear outside its event interval; publisher includes all core clears, phase2 excludes its preceding reset. Buffers/cache state differ from contiguous full-call execution. Do not sum components as a full-call result or use as isolated speedup claim.
component_diagnostic.source: Unmodified candidate phase ABI and publisher

domain_postcheck.row_order: canonical by token/route slot; physical atomic placement may differ

post_reference.scope: Full valid routed domain, FP64 accumulation; exploratory thresholds, not production acceptance

scope_limit: One capture/layer/shape, exploratory arithmetic gates; no vLLM serving or model quality claim
